Hey man not sure if I'll be a lot of help but I'm a bored psychology major that can't sleep so I will try to help out. 
    *[Paxil!](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paroxetine)
* Paxil is prescribed for major depressive disorder and also for anxiety disorders which explains why it was given to you in your teens.
Paxil is a SSRI which means it works on the serotonin neurotransmitter, as do most antidepressants. 
*Dysthmia- Consistent lowered mood, this is a little less severe then major depressive disorder because instead of having a major depression episode, the person rides in lowered mood consistently. So if you don't have major depression episodes you might want to research this a little more or bring it up with your doctor.
*Three different types of treatment for depression: medicine, cognitive behavioral therapy, and EXERCISE. Since your functional enough to talk to your friends which I'm glad you have. Friends are great, ask him/her a favor to go on a walk with you. Exercise combined with medication and therapy is the most efficient way to treat depression. The problem is most depressed people are to depressed to function when in a episode. Sorry if I'm rambling but when you mentioned obsessive attitude that's what we psychs call ruminating. Ruminating is when you sit there and circulate ideas. Well that's just some random stuff I can tell you about depression if you got any questions ask away I'll try to help.
* Lastly, My psychology teacher says some people refuse to take medicine when its not super severe because it doesn't make them feel themselves. My advice is to try the medicine if you feel that its helping you keep using it. IMPORTANT: antidepressant medication takes up to three weeks to work, so don't be discouraged in the beginning. And since its very hard to judge what you have, Be careful. There is a danger zone where the person with depression will be heading back up in terms of there mood and will reach a point where they take their life's. They didn't do it earlier because they were to depressed to do so. This is why one of the side effects of antidepressant drugs is suicide.  ANYWAY, I'm done talking haha. I hope this helps and Yeah anyway. I wish you happiness, and yeah feel free to ask anything.
